authorization.user_statement: Ok move forward chat. Run the 37-frame diagnostic.

selection: Exactly plus/minus two native source frames around the ten committed anchors, clipped to original windows and deduplicated; no selection from diagnostic heatmaps.

policy.mean: original ascending float32 complete contributor context
policy.selection: largest native mass, original component index breaks ties

measurements: every original contributor and averaging attenuation
all components: mass, center, peak, support, rank and matching alternatives
Both old/new mean responses in fixed ten-pixel disks at each available old/new selected center; diagnostic locations, not new labels
limitations: Failure/recovery-selected development context, not a causal test of overfitting or forgetting.
NFHS old caches bind original source/window/frame indices and model identity, not captured PNG or PTS hashes. New manifest provides source frame/PTS mapping.
Historical NFHS cache producer threshold 0.5 is retained; selection parity uses previously published strict 0.3 calibration.
Null or ineligible reference geometry remains null; no inferred centers.
Failed adaptation screen and retained expanded baseline remain unchanged.

scope_preparation_history.event: Before numerical cache reads, added paired fixed-location response at old/new selected centers within the same 74 means, to distinguish ball-response loss from distractor-response gain.
